title: Epidemic Potential of Maravalia cryptostegiae, a Classical Biological Control Agent of Rubber Vine, in Northeastern Brazil
description: Reproducible computational workflow, nonlinear epidemiological models, and evaluation pipelines for evaluating the epidemic potential of Maravalia cryptostegiae, a classical biological control agent of rubber vine (Cryptostegia madagascariensis), in Northeastern Brazil and Queensland, Australia.
